scripts.enquiries: wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --remote --command "SELECT id, substr(created_at,1,16) AS at, email_status, name, email, company, budget, timeline, substr(description,1,60) AS description FROM enquiries ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.enquiries:failed: wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --remote --command "SELECT id, substr(created_at,1,16) AS at, email_status, name, email, substr(email_error,1,120) AS error FROM enquiries WHERE email_status <> 'sent' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.rejections: wrangler d1 execute ded-enquiries --remote --command "SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rejections WHERE created_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-7 days') GROUP BY reason ORDER BY n DESC" --command "SELECT id, substr(created_at,1,16) AS at, reason, email_domain FROM rejections ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
